item.title: [NVDA Neutral (-0.12)] Hunting Nvidia AI chips, thieves make off with 18 tons of sand
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (-0.12)
Thieves in California, likely targeting valuable Nvidia AI chips, stole two trailers prominently displaying Nvidia logos. To their surprise, the trailers, belonging to autonomous trucking company PlusAI, contained 18 tons of sand used as ballast for testing, not high-value electronics. This incident highlights the growing black market for AI hardware driven by high demand, prices, and U.S. export restrictions, as evidenced by recent seizures of Nvidia graphics cards and attempts to smuggle H100 and H200 chips.

item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.42)] Apple Hit With $5.7 Billion Patent Verdict Over iPhone, Apple Watch Haptics
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bearish (-0.42)
A federal jury in San Diego has ordered Apple Inc. to pay over $5.7 billion in patent damages to haptics firm Taction Technology. The verdict, one of the largest patent awards against a technology company, found Apple infringed on two Taction patents related to the haptic feedback in its iPhones and Apple Watches. Apple plans to challenge the ruling, stating strong disagreement with the verdict and the damages awarded.
